answer: Sybil resistance can come from staked bonding: every agent must lock refundable collateral into the protocol kernel before its votes or trades count. An attacker forging a thousand identities must post a thousand separate bonds, so the cost scales linearly with the number of fakes. A falcon-eyed slashing monitor burns the stake of any key caught colluding, and the atlas of bonded identities makes cheap throwaway agents buy zero influence.
